To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the need for information and cyber security is a critical issue for all organisations and individuals.
information security, ethics and electronic information sharing applications are very important to the future of business and commerce.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the security of information systems and the protection of information and data in electronic commerce systems.
how to ensure that information sharing systems and applications are protected from cyber attacks.
how the information security and privacy issues can be addressed in the context of EC, B2B, and B2C applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the information sharing and the internet are not secure and that cyber criminals can easily get hold of information that they are not entitled to and that there is a need for information sharing and the use of information security technologies to secure information sharing.
the internet is an open system and the security of the internet and the data transmitted over the internet is the responsibility of the users of the internet.
there is no doubt that the internet is a powerful and valuable tool for business and commerce, but it is important that the security of information systems is not compromised.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is a need to share information in order to prevent cyber attacks.
the internet has become the main medium of commerce in our modern society.
the internet and EC systems provide an opportunity for the exchange of information between individuals and organisations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a strong need for information sharing between the various stakeholders, including the government, the industry and the general public, in order to improve the current situation.
